intro: A kaya toast set with 2 eggs and kopi is about 480 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the bread, kaya, butter and the sugar in your kopi.
diet: Yes, you can. This set actually has decent protein from the 2 eggs. What you need to watch is the butter, kaya and sugar in your drink. Switch to a less sweet or unsweetened drink and you already save a lot of calories.
tips: Order kopi 'kurang manis' or kopi O kosong.
Ask for a thin layer of butter, or kaya only without butter.
Still hungry? Add another egg, not more toast.

swap.name: Kaya toast (no butter) + 2 eggs + kopi O kosong
swap.why: Same kopitiam breakfast feel, but less fat and sugar.

faq.q: Are half-boiled eggs safe to eat?
faq.a: Most people eat them with no problem. But pregnant mums and people with low immunity should go for fully cooked eggs.
Kaya is made from eggs, santan and sugar, sometimes with pandan leaves.

faq.q: What's the difference between green kaya and brown kaya?
faq.a: Green kaya uses pandan, brown kaya uses caramelised sugar. The taste is a bit different, but the calories are about the same.
